solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Want party to exchange leaders? That'll bring hostile reaction!

indicators.note: the two words swap their opening letters, which is what exchanging leaders asks for

parts.note: to want is to lack
a bash is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: A rowdy celebration that turns into a fight, provoking an angry response.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to exchange leaders' swaps the first letters of LACK and BASH, giving BACK and LASH.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong adverse response, especially a public one, is a synonym for the answer.

clue.text: Recoil from report about distraught Romeo

indicators.note: the word for report goes around the other piece, so it is placed about it

parts.note: a report is a loud noise such as a bang

indicators.note: distraught means upset and disordered, so the letters of Romeo are jumbled

explanation.surface: Romeo, in a state, recoils on hearing some news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recoil' is the verb here: to rebound on the person who started something.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, the answer means to rebound and harm the originator, like the Australian throwing stick returning.

clue.text: Music from revolutionary agent welcomed to state ball

indicators.note: something welcomed to a place is taken into it, so these letters go inside

parts.note: CAL is an abbreviation for California, a US state
O is shaped like a ball

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests turning round, so the word for agent is read backwards

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent

explanation.surface: A political tale of a radical operative welcomed at a state dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns SPY into YPS, which is 'welcomed to' CAL + O.
explanation.definitionFit: A Caribbean song style, originally from Trinidad, with improvised topical lyrics.

clue.text: Raised in family like some wild animal

indicators.note: the word for raised is placed in the word for family

parts.note: a line is a family's lineage
something raised is up

explanation.surface: A child raised among relatives who behaves like a wild beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means wolfish, describing a creature of the wolf kind.

clue.text: Tiger seen abroad where lion holds sway?

indicators.note: abroad can mean all over the place, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A big cat spotted overseas, in the kingdom of the lion.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tanzanian plain is famous savannah territory where lions are top predator.

clue.text: Volume four including books English offered as promised

indicators.note: the first pieces hold the word for books inside them

parts.note: IV is four in Roman numerals
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Reads like a bibliographic note about a volume containing several books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume four' sounds like a book title, but the books slot inside it as the Old Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: A votive offering is one given in fulfilment of a vow.

clue.text: Six men accommodating model tourist

indicators.note: accommodating means housing within, so the other piece goes inside

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
OR (other ranks) stands for ordinary soldiers, or men
to sit is to model for an artist

explanation.surface: Six men put up a fashion model who is touring.
explanation.definitionFit: A tourist is someone who goes to see a place, i.e. a guest from elsewhere.

clue.text: Fossil — see black one with dull exterior

indicators.note: the word for dull forms the exterior, enclosing the other letters

parts.note: trite means hackneyed and dull
lo is an old word meaning see or behold
B is the abbreviation for black on pencils
I is one in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A dark fossil with a dull surface, as a collector might describe it.
explanation.definitionFit: An extinct marine arthropod commonly found preserved in ancient rock.

clue.text: Excellent plonk given at raves

indicators.note: to rave is to talk wildly, so the letters run wild and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cheap wine is praised to the skies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Excellent plonk' is a tongue-in-cheek definition: plonk is cheap wine, so the excellent kind is the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: A wine from a single good year, i.e. high quality wine, joked about as top-grade plonk.

clue.text: One swoops near ground, moving left to right

indicators.note: the letter L, standing for left, is moved from the front to the right-hand end

parts.note: something low is near the ground

explanation.surface: A bird of prey skimming the ground as it flies across.
explanation.walkthrough: L (left) moves from the start of LOW to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A nocturnal bird of prey that drops silently onto its quarry.

clue.text: Consent for each assignment

parts.note: per means for each, as in per person
a mission is an assigned task

explanation.surface: A form asking for agreement on each task given.
explanation.definitionFit: Being allowed to do something means having consent or authorisation.

clue.text: No longer confined, holding on for advocate?

parts.note: ex means former, no longer

indicators.note: the word for confined holds the other piece within it

parts.note: pent, as in pent-up, means shut in

explanation.surface: A freed prisoner who keeps going on, perhaps as a campaigner.
explanation.definitionFit: A promoter or champion of a cause is a synonym, as in an exponent of free trade.

clue.text: Girl brought to mark that locates treasure chest

parts.note: Thora is a girl's name
X marks the spot on a treasure map

explanation.surface: A girl taken to the X on a map, where the treasure chest lies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chest' is not the treasure box: it is the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: Anatomically, this is the part of the body between neck and abdomen.

clue.text: Australia finally getting spinner on

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word for the country

parts.note: a top is a toy that spins

explanation.surface: Australia's spin bowler is at last brought on to bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: The preposition means on top of, resting upon.

clue.text: Rhymester's introduction to The Pit and the Pendulum say

parts.words: The Pit and the Pendulum say
parts.note: the tale is by Edgar Allan Poe, so it stands for his work, with say marking an example
a taster is a small first sample, an introduction

explanation.surface: A poet writes a foreword to Poe's famous horror tale.
explanation.walkthrough: A sample of Poe's writing is a taster of Poe.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhymester is a writer of trivial verse, the same as an inferior poet.

clue.text: Came down after snooze, subdued

indicators.note: the word for came down goes after the word for snooze

parts.note: a snooze is a rest
rain came down, i.e. it rained

explanation.surface: After a nap someone came downstairs, in a quiet mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe holding back, being calm and controlled.

clue.text: Islanders and old volunteers whacked Scotsmen

parts.note: the TA, the Territorial Army, was Britain's former reserve force of volunteer soldiers
whacked means hit
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name, so Scotsmen are Ians

explanation.surface: A brawl in which old soldiers beat up some Scots.
explanation.definitionFit: People of a Polynesian island in French Polynesia are islanders.

clue.text: Action needed about land taken away

indicators.note: the word for action goes about, around, the word for land

parts.note: a deed is an action
a tract is an area of land

explanation.surface: Legal action is required over land that has been confiscated.
explanation.definitionFit: To detract from something is to take away from its value.

clue.text: What one has to go on is fresh and amusing

definitions.text: What one has to go on

parts.note: green means fresh or new
light entertainment is amusing

explanation.surface: Something a person can rely on is new and funny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go on' looks like 'to rely on' but means proceed, as at traffic signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Authorisation to proceed with a project, from the traffic signal meaning go.

clue.text: Rare vacant tenancy agreement — it's free!

indicators.note: vacant means emptied, so only the outer letters of the word remain

parts.note: a lease is a contract for renting property

explanation.surface: An advert for a rare empty property, available at no cost.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, the answer means to set free or liberate.

clue.text: Appears following trouble over affair

indicators.note: the word for appears comes after the other piece
over signals turning back, so the word for trouble is reversed

parts.note: to ail is to trouble
a programme that is on air is on, so appears gives is on

explanation.surface: Someone shows up after a row about an extramarital fling.
explanation.definitionFit: A clandestine romantic or sexual relationship is a synonym.

clue.text: Authentic quartet to be seen in Liechtenstein

indicators.note: a run of four letters can be seen inside the country's name

explanation.surface: A genuine string quartet performing in a small Alpine principality.
explanation.definitionFit: A German-derived word meaning genuine or real, used in English.

clue.text: Tax in one country initially raised money abroad

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means read upwards, so all the letters are reversed
the word for tax goes in the word one

parts.note: VAT is value added tax

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Taxes raised in a single country to bring in foreign cash.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT in ONE gives OVATNE; add C and 'raised' reverses the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: A small coin of several Latin American countries, one hundredth of a peso or similar.

clue.text: Gunners captured by amphibious creatures mounting low attack

indicators.note: the gunners are captured by, held inside, the creatures
in a down clue mounting means going up, so the word is reversed

parts.note: efts are newts
RA is the Royal Artillery

explanation.surface: Artillerymen taken prisoner by newts climbing up for an assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounting' turns EFTS into STFE, which captures RA.
explanation.definitionFit: To attack ground targets from low-flying aircraft with gunfire.

clue.text: Animal, better left in two areas, sent west

indicators.note: in an across clue west is leftwards, so the letters are read backwards
the pieces for better and left go in the two letters for areas

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for area, so two areas give two As
to cap something is to better it

explanation.surface: An animal moved westwards, improved after being left in two regions.
explanation.walkthrough: CAP + L inside A A gives ACAPLA; 'sent west' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A South American camelid related to the llama, kept for its wool.

clue.text: Decline to accept drink, having answer ready for Bulgarian

indicators.note: the word for decline accepts, takes in, the word for drink

parts.note: to sink is to decline
a tot is a small drink

explanation.surface: Someone refuses a drink, prepared with a reply for a Bulgarian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ready' is not prepared: it is slang for cash, as in ready money.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bulgarian coin worth one hundredth of a lev, i.e. Bulgarian small change.

clue.text: Motorway route cut short as data misread

indicators.note: misread suggests the letters are read in the wrong order, so they are rearranged
cut short means the word loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A satnav shortening the journey because it misinterpreted the data.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut short' removes the E of ROUTE; ROUT plus ASDATA is rearranged by 'misread'.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian high-speed road, the equivalent of a motorway.

clue.text: Works informer shifting Republican to the centre

indicators.note: shifting means moving the letter for Republican to a new place
this says where the moved letter goes: into the middle

parts.note: a rat is an informer

explanation.surface: A political informant changes sides, moving to the centre ground.
explanation.walkthrough: R moves from the start of RAT to the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Paintings and sculptures are works, collectively the creative output called art.

clue.text: Impulsive thing in north going after new money

indicators.note: the letter for north goes after the other pieces

parts.note: the euro is a currency

explanation.surface: Someone impulsive in the north chasing new money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Impulsive' suggests rash, but here it means carrying nerve impulses.
explanation.definitionFit: A nerve cell is the body's carrier of electrical signals between brain and body.

clue.text: Sit and adore rippling body

indicators.note: rippling means moving in waves, so the letters are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: An invitation to sit and admire a rippling muscular physique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'body' looks like a physique; it is a celestial body.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor planet orbiting the Sun is a heavenly body.
